tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room no 252, 2nd floor, Gate no 2, M S building

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have executed single order of Rs 6.5 crores/ Two order of Rs. 3.25 crores each/ Three order of Rs 2.17 crores each for supply of SAN Switch / SAN Storage during last 7 years as on bid submission date to any SDC/State Govt Department/GOI Department/Central or State PSU/ Enterprise.
The average annual turnover of the Bidder during the last 3 financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25) shall not be less than Rs.13 Cr (Thirteen Crores only)
